description: This file provides utility functions for root-finding algorithms in univariate analysis, including methods for solving equations, bracketing roots, verifying intervals, and related operations within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: UnivariateSolverUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to assist with root-finding, bracketing, and interval validation in univariate functions.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of a univariate real function over a specified interval using a default solver.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of a univariate real function with specified absolute accuracy.

methods.name: forceSide
methods.description: Adjusts a root approximation found by a non-bracketing solver to lie on a specified side, mimicking bracketing behavior.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Attempts to identify an interval bracketing a root, starting from an initial guess and expanding until a sign change is detected.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Overloaded method with custom parameters for expansion rate and maximum iterations to bracket a root.

methods.name: midpoint
methods.description: Computes the midpoint between two values.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks whether the function values at the interval endpoints bracket a root.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Verifies whether three numbers form a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Checks if the lower and upper bounds define a valid interval.

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Checks if the sequence lower < initial < upper is valid.

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Validates whether the given interval brackets a root of the function.
